subject: Retroactive tier correction and credit authorization for March invoice
messages:
From: Cameron Holt <cam.holt@nimbushealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Nimbus Health Billing <billing@nimbushealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Billing discrepancy for March invoice

Hi Sean —

We were reviewing our March billing (invoice_20270331.pdf attached) and noticed the account slipped into the next usage tier for a 48-hour window on 2027-03-17, which we believe was an ingestion spike from a connector test run on our side. Per our contract tiering rules, usage during that window should have been billed at the lower committed tier. The result is an overage of $12,450 on that invoice.

Can Redwood issue a retroactive tier correction and credit? We can provide the usage export if that helps — attaching a CSV extract of our internal usage and the invoice. Also, for accounting well need a credit note that references our UK VAT registration for Nimbus Health UK (VAT GB123456789).

This is time-sensitive — our auditors are reconciling month-end and we'd like the credit applied before our next payment run on 2027-05-03. Please advise next steps and expected timing.

Thanks,
Cameron Holt
Head of Cloud Operations
Nimbus Health
Phone: +1 (415) 555-2401
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Cameron Holt <cam.holt@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-25T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Billing discrepancy for March invoice

Hi Cameron — thanks for the heads up and the attachments. I pulled the invoice and usage report; the spike you mentioned does align with an anomalous connector batch.

Next steps I propose:
- Finance (ccd: Laura and Marissa) will validate the usage export against our telemetry and calculate the exact credit amount.
- We will prepare a credit note that references Nimbus Health and the VAT GB number you provided. Please confirm whether you want the credit applied to the next invoice or issued as an ACH refund.
- If accepted, we target issuing the credit note and applying the credit by 2027-04-29 so it appears on your account before 2027-05-03 payment run.

Can you confirm the VAT certificate is for the legal entity on file (Nimbus Health UK Ltd)? If yes, attach the VAT cert and I'll loop Finance to expedite.

I'll wait for confirmation and the VAT doc and will follow up internally right away.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Exec, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Cameron Holt <cam.holt@nimbushealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Nimbus Health Billing <billing@nimbushealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-26T09:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Billing discrepancy for March invoice

Thanks Sean. Confirmed — VAT certificate attached (vat_certificate_nimbus_uk.pdf). Legal entity is Nimbus Health UK Ltd.

We've also attached a filtered usage CSV that highlights the 48-hour connector test window (usage_report_March2027.csv). The highlighted rows are the test-run ingestion; none of those sessions are production traffic.

Apply the credit to our next invoice please (we prefer account credit over refund). If you need a signed acknowledgment to close the request, we can do that — please send the credit note and well sign.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Cameron
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Cameron Holt <cam.holt@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-27T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Credit note approved and schedule for application

Hi Cameron — copying the finance and billing team to confirm we reviewed the usage export and internal telemetry.

Summary of resolution:
- Verified: 2027-03-17 03:00–2027-03-19 03:00 UTC spike attributable to your connector test, matched across Redwood telemetry and Nimbus export.
- Approved credit: USD 12,450.00 (service tier misclassification).
- VAT handling: Credit note references Nimbus Health UK Ltd, VAT GB123456789. We will issue the credit note net of VAT per the UK VAT certificate provided. Credit note PDF and signed_ack stub attached (signed_credit_ack.pdf).
- Application: Credit will be applied to your account as an account-level credit and will offset the May invoice generated 2027-05-01. If you prefer a direct refund instead, reply and we'll route via Payments.
- Timeline: Credit note will be generated and uploaded to your HubSpot company record by 2027-04-28; application is scheduled for 2027-05-01 processing so it appears on the 2027-05-01 invoice.

If everything looks correct, no action is required. If you need the credit as a standalone refund, let us know and Finance will initiate an ACH reversal (2–5 business days).

Thanks for the clear evidence. Well follow up if the payments team needs anything else.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Billing Manager
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (650) 555-0198
